wizard.title: Fan discovery
wizard.description: Select the intake (supply) and exhaust fans to balance.

import_config.title: Import configuration
import_config.description: Paste a configuration previously produced by **Export current configuration**. It is validated the same way as the step-by-step wizard before it is accepted.

fan_type.title: Fan control type
fan_type.description: Configure {role} fan **{fan}** ({remaining} more after this one).

data_description.read_only: The balancer will never send commands to this fan; it only reads its current output and counts it towards the total. Use this for a fan controlled by its own logic or by someone else's automation. Night/day ceilings and sensor rules are skipped for a read-only fan, since nothing would ever act on them.

data_description.day_max: Highest step/percent allowed outside quiet hours. Empty = no limit.
data_description.night_max: Highest step/percent allowed in quiet hours. Empty = no limit.

fan_rules.title: Sensor rules
fan_rules.description: Rules of {role} fan **{fan}** ({rules} stored). Output range is 0-{max_level}. Leave the sensor empty to finish.

data.threshold_high_entity: Upper threshold sensor (overrides the fixed number, linear mode)

data_description.threshold_entity: Optional: use another entity's live value as the threshold instead of a fixed number, e.g. a virtual average-humidity sensor.
data_description.threshold_high_entity: Optional: same idea for the upper bound of linear mode.
data_description.delay_seconds: The sensor's active/inactive state must hold steady for this long before it is allowed to change the fan's demand. 0 = instant (default). Useful for a presence sensor that flickers briefly.
data_description.hysteresis: Only for above/below/linear modes. Once active, the rule stays active until the sensor moves this far back past the threshold, instead of deactivating the instant it recrosses it. Prevents the fan from bouncing up and down when the raw value just hovers at the threshold. 0 = none (default, instant on/off at the threshold).

global.title: Global variables
global.description: Occupancy minimums, quiet hours, the hardware command interval and the safety overrides.

data_description.pressure_tolerance: When intake is already at its ceiling and actual exhaust still outruns actual intake by more than this, exhaust fans are paced to close the gap immediately instead of the normal gradual ramp.
data_description.max_correction_seconds: If a fan's real output has not moved at all for this long while it still deviates from its target, force it straight to a safe level, bypassing the normal gradual ramp.

error.fan_in_both_roles: A fan cannot be both intake and exhaust.
error.invalid_airflow_map: Use a non-decreasing comma-separated list with at least two numbers.
error.night_out_of_range: Value is outside the fan range.
error.day_out_of_range: Value is outside the fan range.
error.threshold_required: Set a threshold: a fixed number or a threshold sensor.
error.threshold_high_required: Set an upper threshold: a fixed number or a threshold sensor.
error.threshold_high_invalid: Upper threshold must be greater than the threshold.
error.output_out_of_range: Value is outside the fan range.
error.night_pair_required: Set both night start and night end, or neither.
